input.overview: Scuba rewards completing the five bull's-eye standups hidden around the upper bumpers. Each completion scores 500, advances the plateau, and lights three more rollovers; the fourth plateau lights the yellow bumper. Send the ball between the bumpers early, use grazing target hits to keep it high, and play the low-angle flippers in motion instead of waiting for a cradle.
input.simpleOverview: In Scuba, shoot between the upper bumpers and nudge rebounds across the five bull's-eye standups. Completing all five advances the plateau and lights three rollovers; the fourth plateau lights the yellow bumper. Repeat the target sequence early because the lit lanes and plateau progress carry between balls.
input.summary: Build plateau progress before taking lower-value lanes. The two outside bull's-eye standups are directly shootable; edge hits can send the ball across the three hidden targets. Keep the ball moving and favor outer side-lane exits over the drain-prone inner feeds.

quickInfo.name: Bull's-eye sequence
quickInfo.summary: Complete all five upper standups for 500 points and one plateau advance.

quickInfo.name: Plateau advances
quickInfo.summary: Each plateau lights three more rollovers; the fourth lights the yellow bumper.

quickInfo.name: Later-ball spots
quickInfo.summary: The installed three-ball card can spot outside or alternating bull's-eyes on later balls.

quickInfo.name: Flow play
quickInfo.summary: The low flipper angle makes moving-ball shots more reliable than waiting for a stable cradle.

steps.text: Plunge into a top lane, then watch which bull's-eye targets are already spotted for the current ball.
Send the ball between the upper bumpers and use gentle nudges to carry rebounds across the five bull's-eye standups.
Clip either exposed outside target on its inner edge so the rebound travels toward the three hidden targets.
Repeat the five-target sequence until the useful side lanes and yellow bumper are lit.
When the ball descends, flip early toward the upper playfield and nudge side feeds toward the outer lane or shooter lane.

buildsToward.title: Four plateau advances and a lit yellow bumper

steps.text: Complete the five bull's-eye standups once.
Repeat the reset sequence to light additional rollovers.
Reach the fourth plateau, then keep the ball high for the improved features.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Use an early same-side backhand while the ball is still moving; the low flipper angle rarely offers a dependable cradle.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play and which bull's-eye targets are spotted on later balls; the red-bumper and yellow-bumper lighting schedule can differ by installed card.
Test all five bull's-eye switches and reset, plateau unit and lamps, every lit rollover, red and yellow bumpers, low flipper strength, side-lane feeds, and tilt sensitivity.
